title.rendered: I Am Sealed With the Promised Holy Spirit: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: When you believed, you were marked in Him with a seal, the promised Holy Spirit, who is a deposit guaranteeing our inheritance. You are sealed. The deal is signed in heaven.

content.rendered:
When you believed, you were marked in Him with a seal, the promised Holy Spirit, who is a deposit guaranteeing our inheritance until the redemption of those who are God’s possession. You are sealed. The deal is signed in heaven.

The Gospel For Today | Monday, July 6, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“And you also were included in Christ when you heard the message of truth, the gospel of your salvation. When you believed, you were marked in him with a seal, the promised Holy Spirit, who is a deposit guaranteeing our inheritance until the redemption of those who are God’s possession—to the praise of his glory.”
Ephesians 1:13-14 (NIV)

Today’s Message

In the first century, the seal was one of the most familiar legal images in everyday life. A document was sealed with wax and the signet ring of the one who issued it. The seal marked ownership. It guaranteed authenticity. It declared that the contents belonged to a particular person and that the agreement could not be broken without breaking the seal. Paul reaches for that image to describe what the Holy Spirit does in the life of the believer. You have been sealed with the promised Holy Spirit.

The Greek verb Paul uses is esphragisthēte. It is in the aorist passive tense, meaning the sealing was a completed past action done to you, not by you. You did not seal yourself. The Father sealed you in Christ at the moment you believed. The Holy Spirit Himself is the seal. He took up residence in your inner being and marked you as belonging to God, authenticated as a child of the Father, guaranteed as part of the family forever.

Paul adds a second image alongside the seal. The Holy Spirit is also the deposit guaranteeing your inheritance. The Greek word is arrabōn. It was used in first-century business to describe the down payment that guaranteed the rest of the purchase. When you put down an arrabōn, you were legally committed to follow through with the full payment. Paul says the Holy Spirit Himself is God’s down payment on the full inheritance He has promised the believer. The Spirit in you now is the guarantee of everything God has promised to give you in the age to come.

The implications are enormous. The believer’s salvation is not held together by their willpower. It is held together by the indwelling Holy Spirit who has been given as a seal and a deposit. The believer’s standing with God is not at the mercy of their last performance. It is secured by the Spirit who marked them at the moment they believed. The believer’s future inheritance is not theoretical. It is guaranteed by the down payment of the Spirit who is already present in their inner being.

For Gospelbuzz readers, the truth this morning is settled. You are sealed. The Holy Spirit lives in you. The deposit on your inheritance is already in. The deal is signed in heaven. Whatever the enemy whispers to make you doubt your standing with God, the seal is unbroken and the Spirit remains. Walk in that security today.

Prayer

Father, I acknowledge that I am sealed with the promised Holy Spirit. The Spirit Himself lives in me as Your seal and the deposit guaranteeing my inheritance. I am marked as belonging to You. I am authenticated as Your child. The seal is unbroken. The Spirit remains. My salvation is not held by my willpower. It is held by the indwelling Spirit who came at the moment I believed. I walk in this security today, settled, sealed, and confident in You. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

I am sealed with the promised Holy Spirit. The Spirit Himself is the deposit guaranteeing my inheritance. I belong to God. The seal is unbroken.
